disposition: Approved as a predeclared fallback for the final Forward+ pilot_north field workload.

reason.outcome: Three field invocations completed. The fourth baseline import completed; the final field frame, checked field report and four-block results.json are absent. The observed outer 45-minute cancellation leaves no complete ABBA comparison.

scope.trigger: Own workflow path on the audit branch or manual dispatch. The regular audit does not watch the recovery workflow file.
scope.workflow_comparison: Parsed both YAML documents and compared all seven job steps. After normalizing only checkout ref, matrix substitutions for the concrete renderer/workload and artifact name, every step and command matched. The job retains the same imports, pinned engine, resource sampler, environment, 60 warmups, 31 raw samples and first-interval exclusion. All four field processes must exit cleanly on one VM. The workflow has read-only repository permissions.

selection.rule: Use a qualified original final 1e91 Forward+ pilot_north four-launch result whenever present. Use the recovery only when the original is explicitly failed, canceled, incomplete, or fails the pre-existing qualification checks. An in-progress original is pending. If both qualify, retain both attempts but select the original. A validated recovery selection must use its own complete A/B/B/A block; cross-job launch pooling and selection by speed are excluded.
selection.hardware_scope: The recovered result would characterize the software Vulkan runner. It cannot establish performance on a target GPU.
